title: WorkItem
description: One item read from a source: a tracker issue or an open pull request, which a manager scout reads, or a grimoire run, which scripts/manager.mjs reads itself from the run journals (kind run, never from a scout). The scouts return a JSON array of these; scripts/manager.mjs validates it with a hand-written check of exactly these rules and refuses the whole file on any error. Every optional field takes null, which reads as absent; a required one never does. Urgency and groups are computed by the script from the fields: bucketHint and nextStep are the model's reading, and bucketHint never makes an item urgent. Ticket text (title, nextStep, names) is data: the briefing escapes it.

date.description: An ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD, read in the machine's time zone) or date-time. It must name a real calendar day and clock time: the script refuses 2026-02-30T10:00:00Z, which the pattern alone allows.

refs.description: Other items, by their id or key. null or absent: none read.

sourceId.description: The manager.sources[].id this item was read from ("tracker" when the config has no manager block).

id.description: The tracker's stable id: Linear's identifier (ODY-871), Jira's key, GitHub's owner/repo#n. Unique per source.

key.description: The short id a person reads (ODY-871, #12). null or absent: the id.

url.description: The item's web link. Only http(s) links are rendered as links.

stateType.description: The tracker state mapped onto Linear's state types. completed and canceled items are counted, not listed.

nativeState.description: The tracker's own status name ("In Review").

priority.description: Linear's scale: 0 none (ranks last), 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low. null or absent: the script maps nativePriority by manager.priorityLabels; with nativePriority absent too, the most urgent of labels[] that maps; else 0. An explicit value, 0 included, is kept: no fallback.

nativePriority.description: The tracker's own priority ("Highest", a P1 label). With priority absent or null, a label here is mapped by manager.priorityLabels (case-insensitive; the defaults when the config has none), the same table the scout uses.

assignee.description: Who it is assigned to (a display name), or null when unassigned.

lastActivityAt.description: The newest activity seen (the update, the last comment). Started work with none for manager.urgent.stalledDays is urgent; absent, updatedAt is read.

blockedBy.description: The open items blocking this one. Absent means none.

blocks.description: The open items this one blocks. Absent means none. Not started work blocking manager.urgent.blocksAtLeast open items is urgent; an id the briefing did not read counts as open.

parentOf.description: This item's sub-issues. Non-empty makes it a parent issue.

sliced.description: true when the project went through spec, plan and to-issues (slice-tagged issues).

repo.description: The repos[].name in grimoire.config.json the item maps to, or null when unsure.

hasAcceptanceCriteria.description: The description states verifiable acceptance criteria (an Acceptance criteria / Done when section or a checklist of outcomes). null or absent: the description was not read, shown as "not checked"; only true makes an issue ready for AI.

linkedPr.description: The URL or id of a pull request linked to the item, or null.

bucketHint.description: The model's reading, for what needs reading (waiting on someone outside the team, explicitly parked). It moves an item only between the non-urgent groups (ai, waiting, notnow), and into ai only when the item is eligible; it never makes an item urgent and never moves one out of Decide or Do.

nextStep.description: One line: what to do next, from what the ticket says.

reviewDecision.description: A pull request's (kind pr) review decision, GitHub's value as gh gives it; null or absent when the repo requires none (gh's empty string). APPROVED and not merged is Do.

checks.description: A pull request's CI, from statusCheckRollup: failing when any check failed, errored, timed out, was cancelled or needs action; else pending while any runs or waits; else passing. null or absent: no checks. failing is Do.

reviewRequested.description: A pull request with a review request still pending, from anyone asked (reviewRequests not empty). true is Decide.

isDraft.description: A draft pull request. true is Not now, whatever its checks or review say.

needsAttention.description: A grimoire run's (kind run) tasks that never landed or are still running past their limit. Written by scripts/manager.mjs, never by a scout.

haltReason.description: Why a halted grimoire run (kind run) stopped, its halt's first line. Written by scripts/manager.mjs, never by a scout.
